name: toroid_small_shield_epoxy
notes: Replica of the 2022 COMSOL model Toroid_With_Epoxy/Small_Shield.mph (arXiv:2211.00008, shielded LOSSY toroid). Identical to toroid_small_shield_lossless.json (same sheath, bridge, port, shield, source, mesh C settings) plus the TACHYON 100G region of the COMSOL file: wp1 squares sq2 (corner 0.525,0.025; side 0.45) and sq3 (corner 0.5475,0.0475; side 0.405) revolved 0-355 deg; COMSOL domain 3 = sq2 minus sq3 (decoded mesh: r 0.530-0.974, z 0.027-0.469) carries mat4, i.e. a hollow square lining 2.25 cm thick on the inside of the 2.5 cm walls, open at the gap faces like the interior. Area (= volume, both centroids at R = 0.75) fraction of the interior: (0.45^2-0.405^2)/0.45^2 = 19.0 %, the paper's ~20 % 'lossier' case (Fig. S3). Material (COMSOL LossTangentDF): eps' = linear interpolation/extrapolation of (2 GHz, 3.04), (5 GHz, 3.02), (10 GHz, 3.02) -> 3.05333 - 6.667e-12 f[Hz] (3.0533 at 5 MHz, 3.0523 at 150 MHz), tan_delta = 0.0021, mu_r 1, sigma 0. COMSOL (exp(+jwt)) eps = eps'(1 - j tan_delta) == axionFEM (exp(-iwt)) eps'(1 + i tan_delta). The per-frequency production jobs set eps_r to eps'(f). The axion source (COMSOL Je on domains 3 and 4 = whole interior) is the same toroidal_box as the lossless replica. Solver: AMS-GMRES (the STRUMPACK path rejects complex material coefficients), one frequency per job.
